# Compass — Free Immigration Insights & Green Card Tracker

> Compass is a free, open-source web application that provides data-driven immigration insights for employment-based (EB) green card applicants. Built on 18.5M+ government data points from the US Department of Labor, USCIS, State Department, and Bureau of Labor Statistics.

## What Compass Does

Compass helps people navigating the US employment-based immigration system by providing:

- **Priority Date Forecasting**: Machine learning predictions for when EB1, EB2, and EB3 priority dates will become current, based on 15 years of Visa Bulletin history
- **Employer Sponsorship Scores**: Sponsor Reliability Score (SRS) for 70,000+ employers showing H-1B and PERM approval rates, denial trends, and wage competitiveness
- **Salary Benchmarks**: H-1B and PERM salary data by employer and occupation with p10-p90 percentile bands and 5-year growth trends
- **Visa Bulletin Tracking**: Monthly cutoff trends for Dates for Filing (DFF) and Final Action Date (FAD) across all EB categories and countries
- **EB Category Comparison**: Side-by-side velocity and volatility analysis for EB1 vs EB2 vs EB3
- **Geographic Heatmaps**: H-1B and PERM filing activity by US state with approval rates and wage data
- **Occupation Demand**: Which SOC codes have the highest sponsorship demand and approval rates
- **Processing Speed**: USCIS quarterly throughput, approval rates, and backlog trends
- **Backlog Visualization**: Queue depth estimates and years-to-clear projections by country and category
- **Approval & Denial Trends**: 19 years of PERM labor certification outcomes with administration-era policy analysis

## Data Sources

All data comes from official US government sources:

- **Department of Labor (DOL)**: PERM labor certification disclosure data, LCA (Labor Condition Application) data
- **USCIS**: Employment-based approval and denial statistics, processing data
- **State Department**: Monthly Visa Bulletin with priority date cutoffs (2011-2026)
- **Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS)**: Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics (OEWS) for national salary benchmarks

## Key Pages

- `/` — Home page with key statistics and dashboard navigation
- `/insights/` — Personalized dashboard: enter your priority date, employer, and job to get tailored forecasts
- `/dashboard/visa-bulletin/` — Priority date cutoff trends and 24-month ML forecasts
- `/dashboard/employer/` — Sponsor Reliability Score lookup for 70,000+ employers
- `/dashboard/wage/` — H-1B and PERM salary benchmarks by employer and occupation
- `/dashboard/eb-category/` — EB1 vs EB2 vs EB3 movement velocity comparison
- `/dashboard/geographic/` — H-1B and PERM activity heatmap by US state
- `/dashboard/job-demand/` — Occupation demand rankings for immigration sponsorship
- `/dashboard/processing/` — USCIS processing speed and throughput trends
- `/dashboard/backlog/` — Green card queue depth and years-to-clear estimates
- `/dashboard/approvals/` — PERM approval and denial trends (1992-2025)
- `/about/` — Project story, data pipeline, and technology
- `/ask/` — Immigration Q&A powered by pre-computed answers
- `/privacy/` — Privacy policy (zero data collection)
- `/terms/` — Terms of use

## Technical Details

- Static site (no server, no database, no API)
- All computations run in the user's browser
- Data updated monthly when new government releases are available
- Open source: https://github.com/v-rathod/immigration-insights-app

## Contact

- GitHub: https://github.com/v-rathod/immigration-insights-app

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q: How long will my EB-2 green card take? What's my priority date?**
A: Compass predicts green card wait times using 15 years of Visa Bulletin history and machine learning. Enter your priority date on `/dashboard/visa-bulletin/` to see personalized 24-month forecasts for your category and country. No login required.

**Q: Which employers have the best green card sponsorship track record?**
A: Search 70,000+ employers on `/dashboard/employer/` to see their Sponsor Reliability Score (SRS), H-1B and PERM approval rates, denial trends, and hiring volume. Data based on 18.5M USCIS records.

**Q: What salary should I negotiate for an H-1B or PERM role?**
A: View historical salary data by employer and job title on `/dashboard/wage/`. Compass shows p10-p90 percentile bands, 5-year salary growth trends, and how each employer compares to national benchmarks from the Bureau of Labor Statistics.

**Q: Is my occupation in high demand for immigration sponsorship?**
A: Check `/dashboard/job-demand/` to see which SOC codes have the highest H-1B and PERM sponsorship activity, approval rates, and wage competitiveness.

**Q: How many years is the EB-2 India backlog?**
A: Compass tracks `/dashboard/backlog/` to show queue depth estimates and years-to-clear projections by country and category, updated quarterly from USCIS data.

**Q: What's the difference between EB-1, EB-2, and EB-3?**
A: Visit `/dashboard/eb-category/` for a side-by-side comparison of visa category velocity, volatility, and approval rates. EB-1 moves fastest, EB-3 is slowest but has shorter visa bulletin waits.

**Q: How fast is USCIS processing I-485 and I-140 cases right now?**
A: Check `/dashboard/processing/` to see latest quarterly throughput, approval rates, and USCIS backlog trends by benefit type.

**Q: Are there any immigration insights specific to my priority date and employer?**
A: Go to `/insights/` (our personalized dashboard). Enter your priority date, employer name, and job title to get a customized forecast and comparison to industry benchmarks.

**Q: How is Compass different from other immigration trackers?**
A: Compass is built on 18.5M+ official government data points from USCIS, DOL, and State Department. We offer ML-powered forecasts, no login required, zero ads, zero data collection, and completely free access. All code is open source.

**Q: Why does Compass have no login?**
A: We believe immigration data should be freely accessible without friction. Compass runs entirely in your browser — no data is stored on our servers, no login required, no tracking.

**Q: Can I use Compass on my phone?**
A: Yes. Compass is fully responsive and works on mobile browsers. All dashboards and features are mobile-friendly.

**Q: Is Compass affiliated with USCIS or the State Department?**
A: No. Compass is an independent open-source project built by an immigrant. We only use publicly available government data. We are not affiliated with any government agency.
